characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Young female with a slim build and fair complexion. She has dark hair slicked back behind her ears and symmetrical, smooth facial features. Her appearance is highly polished and slightly artificial.

characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young female with a medium build and medium complexion. She has dark, wavy, shoulder-length hair and expressive facial features. Her appearance is natural and relatable.
characters.demeanor: Expressive, animated, shifting from frustrated to surprised.

scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: Ah!
Unknown Voice says: What happened?
Priya says: My hands on fire!
Miss Nova says: Actually, it's "My hands are burning."
Priya says: Easy for you to say! I freeze every time I have to speak English.
Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova. I teach English on Supernova AI, by actually making you speak.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable Indian-English error and live correction.
- Emotion: Frustration turning into curiosity.
- Payload: (c) You speak, not type/read. Names English and Miss Nova early.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: I analyze your exact level and build a personalized plan just for you.
Priya says: But what if I make mistakes? I feel so shy.
Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes! No one is judging you here. I correct you and explain the logic in your own language.
Miss Nova says: Practice real-life scenarios for fifteen minutes a day, and you will start seeing visible progress in a month.
